scope: Ten directly located research items and technical articles relevant to project management, execution, verification, and agent cost. Does not imply one item from each requested provider.

sourceCoverage.NeurIPS: workshop discovered, no additional study included

studies.title: ESAA: Event Sourcing for Autonomous Agents in LLM-Based Software Engineering
studies.insight: Separate agent intentions from deterministic state mutations; replay event log.

studies.title: Verification as an Architectural Layer for LLM Agents
studies.insight: Pair requirements with deterministic gates and optional LLM review; small pilot, not general proof.

studies.title: Engineering Sustainable Agents
studies.insight: Multi-agent overhead can dominate simple tasks; route to cheapest adequate workflow.

studies.title: Effective Strategies for Asynchronous Software Engineering Agents
studies.insight: Relevant asynchronous SWE agent work; paper abstract and evaluation not independently extracted.

studies.title: EnterpriseOps-Gym: Environments and Evaluations for Stateful Agentic Planning and Tool Use in Enterprise Settings
studies.insight: Stateful enterprise tools and access protocols expose weak long-horizon agent reliability.

studies.title: MAS-ProVe: Understanding the Process Verification of Multi-Agent Systems
studies.insight: Process verifiers are not reliably better; measure verifier value before adding complexity.

studies.title: Verification-Aware Planning for Multi-Agent Systems (VeriMAP)
studies.insight: Model task dependencies and explicit passing criteria per subtask.

studies.title: SWE-Bench Pro: Can AI Agents Solve Long-Horizon Software Engineering Tasks?
studies.insight: Test agents on long-horizon repository tasks rather than short toy examples.

studies.title: Active-SWE: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Proactive Bug Fixing without Issue Reports
studies.insight: Proactive issue discovery is difficult; require reproducible evidence before claiming fixes.

studies.title: The Agent Development Lifecycle
studies.insight: Build, test, deploy and monitor as a repeatable gated cycle.
